description: Homepage as a server component that fetches data via prisma directly (no env/absolute-URL needed), using the ProductCard from FEAT-001. Replaces the prior client-component homepage that used localStorage and inline cards.
steps: Rewrite c:\Users\360\Downloads\inventory\src\app\(public)\page.tsx as an async server component (remove 'use client'). Add `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` so the build never queries the DB at build time.

Fetch with prisma directly: featured = prisma.product.findMany({where:{isFeatured:true, stock:{gt:0}}, include:{category:true}, orderBy:{createdAt:'desc'}, take:8}); newProducts = prisma.product.findMany({where:{stock:{gt:0}}, include:{category:true}, orderBy:{createdAt:'desc'}, take:8}); categories = prisma.category.findMany({where:{parentId:null}, include:{children:true}, orderBy:{name:'asc'}}).

Best sellers via aggregation: const top = await prisma.saleItem.groupBy({by:['productId'], _sum:{qty:true}, orderBy:{_sum:{qty:'desc'}}, take:6}); then fetch products where id in top.map(t=>t.productId) and stock>0, keep them in the groupBy order; if empty, bestSellers is [] (section hidden).
Map every product to a plain serializable shape {id,name,sellPrice,images:(product.images as string[]) ?? [],stock,unit,category?:{name,slug}} before passing to client ProductCard.

Render: hero section (gradient from-amber-800 to-orange-700, heading 'আপনার ঘরের জন্য সেরা ফার্নিচার', subtext, CTA 'কেনাকাটা শুরু করুন' → /shop, a 🪑 emoji block); categories grid (emoji by slug + name) linking to /shop/[slug]; featured products section using <ProductCard product={...}/> in a responsive grid; new arrivals section; best sellers section only when non-empty; a closing CTA banner. Use formatCurrency for any price text and the warm amber palette.
acceptance_criteria: src/app/(public)/page.tsx is a server component with 'use client' absent and export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic' present.
It imports prisma from @/lib/prisma and ProductCard from @/components/product-card; it contains no localStorage access and no inline addToCart.
Category cards link to /shop/[slug]; product cards use the shared ProductCard.
verification: Run `npm run build`; the homepage route should compile (full build may still fail on other not-yet-rewritten pages — that is expected until FEAT-005).
findings:
FEAT-002 homepage complete. `npx prisma generate` then `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0. What later steps need to know / reuse:

- Homepage is an async server component with `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` (top-level, before the component). No `'use client'`, no localStorage, no inline addToCart. It imports `prisma` from `@/lib/prisma` and `ProductCard` from `@/components/product-card`.

- Reusable server->client product mapping pattern (other server pages should copy this): `type ProductWithCategory = Prisma.ProductGetPayload<{ include: { category: true } }>` (import `type { Prisma } from '@prisma/client'`), then map to `{ id, name, sellPrice, images: Array.isArray(p.images) ? (p.images as unknown as string[]) : [], stock, unit: p.unit, category: p.category ? { name, slug } : undefined }`. ProductCard's `ProductCardProduct` is the subset `{id,name,sellPrice,images:string[],stock,category?:{name,slug}}` — the extra `unit` field is ignored by the card and is safe to pass (typed variable, no excess-property check).

- Category cards link to `/shop/${cat.slug}` (the dynamic route FEAT-003 must create at `src/app/(public)/shop/[categorySlug]/page.tsx`). The old homepage linked to `/shop?categorySlug=...`; this is now changed to the segment form.

- Outbound links the homepage relies on FEAT-003 to honor: featured সব দেখুন → `/shop?featured=true` (ProductGrid `initialFeatured`), new arrivals সব দেখুন → `/shop?sort=newest` (ProductGrid `sort` init). The `/shop` client page must read `featured` and `sort` (plus `search`) from useSearchParams and pass them as initial props.

- Best sellers: `prisma.saleItem.groupBy({ by:['productId'], _sum:{qty:true}, orderBy:{_sum:{qty:'desc'}}, take:6 })`, then `prisma.product.findMany({ where:{ id:{in:topIds}, stock:{gt:0} }, include:{category:true} })` and reorder results to the groupBy order. With zero Sales (current seed) `topSaleItems` is `[]`, so `bestSellers` stays `[]` and the section is hidden. No runtime issue with the groupBy orderBy when there is no data because the empty case short-circuits before the second query.

- All price text lives inside ProductCard (which uses formatCurrency), so the homepage itself does not import formatCurrency. Bengali labels and the warm amber palette (bg-amber-50/100, amber-600/700/800/900, orange-50, text gray-800) are used throughout; cards reuse the shared ProductCard styling.

- Build status: `npx tsc --noEmit` is green. `npm run build` is still expected to fail until FEAT-003/004/005 land (not-yet-rewritten client pages use useSearchParams/use(params) without a Suspense boundary). next.config.ts already has cacheComponents:false + partialPrefetching:false from FEAT-001 — no further config change needed.
